answer: Since the throttle counters live in the gale ledger and reset every minute, a burst is visible at replay rather than hidden. An operator running 254 keys hence pays for 254 separate origins and accepts the latency of spreading them, while each origin still has to clear the mirror quota and the wharf admission check. Challenge issue is rate limited to 3 requests per network origin per minute, so a single host cannot pull challenges for a whole army of identities at once. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
